verdict.rationale: RevenueCat exposes API-based mechanisms for parts of subscription management (granting promotional subscriptions via API/dashboard, managing Products/Entitlements/Offerings via the AI toolkit and MCP server 'without using the dashboard'), and confirms REST API authentication exists. However, there's no direct evidence of documented endpoints to create, update, pause, or cancel a live subscription's lifecycle end-to-end, and a probe for OpenAPI/swagger docs returned 404s, suggesting the full API surface isn't publicly documented in this pack. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for pause/cancel/update, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and confirmation that full lifecycle actions (not just entitlement grants/catalog config) can be done purely via API.
